# AI Teammate Dashboard

Teams会議の暗黙知蓄積AIエージェントの運用ダッシュボード

content.query: customEvents | where name == 'MeetingJoined' | summarize count() by bin(timestamp, 1d) | order by timestamp asc
content.title: 会議セッション数（日次推移）

content.query: customMetrics | where name == 'AnalysisLatencyMs' | summarize avg(value), percentile(value, 95) by bin(timestamp, 1h) | order by timestamp asc
content.title: AI分析レイテンシ（平均・P95）

content.query: customEvents | where name == 'AnalysisExecution' | summarize QuestionsGenerated=sum(todouble(customMeasurements['QuestionsGenerated'])), TopicsDetected=sum(todouble(customMeasurements['TopicsDetected'])) by bin(timestamp, 1d)
content.title: 質問生成数・トピック検出数

content.query: customEvents | where name == 'KnowledgeIngestion' | summarize count() by tostring(customDimensions['Category']) | order by count_ desc
content.title: ナレッジ蓄積数（カテゴリ別）

content.query: customMetrics | where name in ('AIPromptTokens', 'AICompletionTokens') | summarize TotalTokens=sum(value) by name, bin(timestamp, 1d) | order by timestamp asc
content.title: AIモデルトークン消費量

content.query: exceptions | summarize count() by type, bin(timestamp, 1d) | order by timestamp asc
content.title: エラー率とエラー種別

content.query: customEvents | where name == 'UserInteraction' | summarize count() by tostring(customDimensions['ActionType']), bin(timestamp, 1d) | order by timestamp asc
content.title: ユーザーアクティビティ
